title: Sun in 1st House Transit: Impact on Your Dasha
description: Discover how the Sun transiting the 1st house affects your personality, vitality, and your Net Dasha Flow score.
content: When the Sun transits the 1st house (the Ascendant), it brings a massive surge of vitality, ego, and self-focus. Depending on your current Mahadasha and Antardasha, this transit can act as a powerful multiplier. If you are running a favorable Dasha, the Sun in the 1st house illuminates your path to success and leadership. However, if your Dasha is challenging, this transit can lead to ego clashes, overheating, and unnecessary pride. Calculate your precise Transit Weighted NDF Flow to see exactly how this impacts your timeline.

title: Jupiter in 4th House Transit: Home and Happiness
description: Learn what happens when Jupiter transits the 4th house of home, mother, and emotional security.
content: Jupiter's transit through the 4th house expands your inner world, bringing potential for real estate gains, peace at home, and educational success. As a natural benefic, its transit here is generally supportive. In the Tara Nirnay NDF system, a Jupiter 4th house transit acts as a positive multiplier for any Dasha related to domestic peace or property. If you are running a difficult Dasha, this transit can provide much-needed emotional cushioning and support from family.

title: Rahu in 5th House Transit: Creativity and Illusion
description: Understand the intense effects of Rahu transiting the 5th house of creativity, romance, and speculation.
content: Rahu in the 5th house transit creates an obsession with creativity, sudden speculative gains (or losses), and intense romantic encounters. Because Rahu represents illusion and expansion without limits, this transit can wildly skew your Net Dasha Flow. If you are in a Rahu or Venus Dasha, this transit might indicate sudden explosive success in creative fields or risky investments. Check your Tara Nirnay Dasha chart to see if your Transit Multiplier favors this placement.
